description: Change a report: its name, its filters, the columns it shows, how it is sorted, how many records a page holds. Pass only what changes. `criterias` REPLACES all the report's filters. `group_field_ids` REPLACES its grouping (798): an empty list makes it a plain list again; a total or an average needs a grouping. Ids come from get_reports.

average_by_group.description: false removes the average; true goes with average_by_group_column_id

average_by_group_column_id.description: The number field averaged in each group (id or name); an empty string removes the average

criterias.description: The report's filters, ALL of them: this list replaces the ones it has (an empty list removes every filter). Same shape as in create_report.

group_field_ids.description: The fields the records are grouped by, ALL of them (ids or names); an empty list removes the grouping

only_groupname_and_count.description: true = show only each group's name and how many records it holds

per_page.description: Number of records per page (max 100, default 20)

property_ids.description: The columns shown, ALL of them (field ids or names); an empty list shows every column

sort_by.description: Field id or name to sort the records by

total_by_group.description: false removes the total; true goes with total_by_group_column_id

total_by_group_column_id.description: The number field summed in each group (id or name); an empty string removes the total

name: update_report
